awaiting_human.question: What is the Column One/Column Two Indicator (CCMI) for the 97150–97140 pair in the CMS NCCI PTP edit file for Q3 2026 (effective 2026-07-01)?
awaiting_human.why_needed: CCMI=1 means a modifier (59/XE/XS/XP/XU) can bypass the edit and the line should be resubmitted via reopening with the appropriate modifier. CCMI=0 means no bypass is permitted and the line must be written off. The 835 does not carry this value.
